_comment: Zone A of Hongdae: the intersection at the start and the first 20 m of the narrow red street, with the Blue Elephant corner building.
Hand-measured vector plan in Unreal metres (X along the street, Y right, Z up), read off the scan's top-down orthophoto
(SourceAssets/RoadLayers/Hongdae_road.png, 2.5 cm/px), the facade-line density map and the baked facade photos
(SourceAssets/Rebuilt/Hongdae/face_029.png and face_031.png, 1.25 cm/px). Expected error about 0.2-0.3 m.
Ground heights are not authored: they come from the collision floor (make_scan_collision.py).
Road markings are not authored either: they are extracted from the orthophoto (white and yellow paint).

building.name: BlueElephant
building._source: footprint from the facade-line density map; storeys, openings, signs and awnings measured on the baked facade photos; depth beyond y 16.6 and the roof top estimated

scan_buildings._comment: building interiors behind measured facade lines that the collision floor counts as open; no ground mesh here

_sidewalk_note: sidewalk polygons reach ~0.5 m under the scanned building walls they meet, so no gap opens at the wall base
